early_transient_path_incident.cause: The existing MathVision build_scene implementation hardcodes its temporary scene-copy root. Initial config/TEMP redirection did not override that assignment.
early_transient_path_incident.cleanup: Existing TemporaryDirectory context managers automatically removed those transient copies.
early_transient_path_incident.correction: Shared runtime_isolation.py redirects only that in-memory temporary path and installs a Python filesystem write guard. No checked-in code was changed.

subsequent_render_isolation.write_guard: Python filesystem writes outside root runtime are denied by an audit hook.
subsequent_render_isolation.drawing_code_and_frozen_geometry: Unchanged; baseline and candidate pixel checks remain mandatory.

file_audit.scope: Existing files outside the new root runtime folder, excluding .git directories. Formal files are SHA-256 checked; pre-existing .runtime/cache files use size/mtime metadata to avoid blocking on runtime handles.
file_audit.latest_recorded_result: No changed, deleted, or added files outside root runtime.
